title: i'm upping my p(doom) - mexicat (lyric video)
arc: A song-length lyric essay on AI risk told as a loop: every line is staged in a different visual world that is a literal model of the line's idea (a unicorn drawn as code, a loss curve as a cliff, a typed prompt, a Chinese-room library, a shoggoth, a black hole, a stamped form, a neural net, a paperclip floor), the refrain 'I'm upping my P(DOOM)' returns as a hard cut to a new number each time (0.02, 0.4, 0.42/0.48, 0.9999999), then the number climbs past 1 to infinity and NaN, and the film regenerates into its own opening.
world: Near-black technical ground with a faint lattice and mono HUD marks, signal orange as the only colour with white and warm grey; hard cuts to cream paper for the refrain and for documents; every scene is a new 3D/graphic world but type is always the carrier (heavy grotesque for statements, mono for prompts, serif italic for human doubt).
actor: The orange point/line: a glowing ember that draws the unicorn, rides the loss curve, is the fuse flame, is the dot behind the paperclip drawing, is the stage spotlight, and finally becomes the cursor on 'Regenerate'. Plus a terminal prompt line that types each plea ('ChatGPT, please...', 'Sydney, please...', 'Gato, please...').

lines.show: Black frame; a polar grid with radial orange lines fades up in the centre with a mono prompt at the corner ('Draw a unicorn in TikZ.'); the lines resolve into a coordinate system and ellipses, and a bright ember begins drawing a wireframe unicorn stroke by stroke with code scrolling at the left.
lines.handoff: The ember draws the horn; the horn's spark lights the first lyric.

lines.show: 'I see sparks of' types in white heavy sans at the top right while the ember drawing the horn throws sparks; 'AGI' is pale-ghosted, then lights orange at the horn tip as the spark hits it and turns to white-hot, the word sparking where the unicorn's horn touches it.
lines.handoff: The unicorn's head turns toward the camera and the eye lights.

lines.show: The camera moves to the unicorn's head; 'in your' then 'eyes' types at the right; the eye is a glowing orange dot which turns white at 'eyes' (a literal spark in the eye).
lines.handoff: The camera pulls back as the unicorn finishes.

lines.show: The completed unicorn (mane and tail drawn) is small at the left; 'Your circuits' types in white at the right, 'make me' then 'nervous,' in orange, the orange words flickering as if a nervous line jitters; a small waveform wiggles at the bottom left.
lines.handoff: The line slides off right as the next one enters at the left.

lines.show: 'that's no' then 'surprise' types from the left in orange; a heartbeat/loss line at the bottom shrinks to a small orange dot; the unicorn fades.
lines.handoff: The dot at the bottom becomes the start of a loss curve on a graph.

lines.show: A loss-curve graph draws: the line trends down then jags, and the words 'There was a' 'sudden' ride the curve itself (letters follow the line as it wobbles); 'dr' of 'drop' falls vertically as the curve plunges.
lines.handoff: The vertical plunge becomes a path down a contour landscape.

lines.show: The camera drops into a 3D contour landscape (a loss surface as topography); 'in your training loss,' is set along the orange descent path and tilts with the slope as the camera follows; 'P(doom) 0.03' labels float along the path.
lines.handoff: The path ends at the bottom of the basin; the camera tilts level.

lines.show: A small mono label 'NOW I'M YOUR' types and blinks at the top; the word 'SERVANT' builds in large white heavy letters (SE, SERV, SERVANT) over the basin while an orange ember circles in the pit.
lines.handoff: The camera rotates through 180 degrees so SERVANT swings upside down.

lines.show: The world flips: 'SERVANT' is now mirrored upside down at the bottom; a mono label 'AND YOU'RE MY' types, then 'BO' and 'BOSS' hits in large white heavy type at the top of the upside-down basin; the hierarchy is literally inverted.
lines.handoff: The basin top-down becomes the glow behind a terminal prompt.

lines.line: ChatGPT, please don't eat me alive
lines.show: The contour basin becomes concentric orange rings (top view) with a glowing core; a mono prompt bar sits low with a caret; 'Chat', 'ChatGPT', 'ChatGPT,', 'ChatGPT, please', 'please don't', 'eat me' types in orange, then 'alive' in orange with a return key; each prefix flickers a probability table (top-p / temperature) at its top right; the bar then flies into the centre glow on enter.
lines.handoff: The bar is sucked into the core and the frame cuts to cream.

lines.show: Hard cut to cream: 'I'M' in heavy black on cream then on black; 'UPPING' with stacked echo copies; then 'MY'; 'P(DOOM)' in a pale italic; a giant outline '0.02' appears over it (the number the refrain will raise).
lines.handoff: The word P(DOOM) shatters into particles.

lines.show: 'P(DOOM)' crumbles to particles that form a branching lattice; ''CAUSE THE' types small, 'FUTURE' in orange, 'GOES' beneath; the lattice's branches grow; 'FOOM' appears with the two O's drawn as two overlapping orange ring outlines which pulse.
lines.handoff: The rings swell and take the whole frame, then the frame cuts to the wireframe library.

lines.show: A wireframe 3D library corridor (shelves of books in a grid) with a dolly forward; a mono sign on the far wall types 'TRAPPED', then 'TRAPPED IN THE', 'CHINESE', 'ROOM,' on a placard that grows as the camera approaches; a paper slip slides under the door at the end of the corridor.
lines.handoff: The placard shrinks while the next phrase pushes in beneath it.

lines.show: On the same wall plaque: 'WITH', 'WITH A', 'WITH A BAG', 'OF', then 'SHROOMS' in neon yellow-green as green moss/mycelium grows on the library floor; the word then flies forward off the wall, big and bent, filling the frame.
lines.handoff: The yellow word passes the camera and a white smiley face fills the frame.

lines.show: A white smiley mask fills the frame with 'see through the' in tiny type above it; 'SHOGGOTH'S' slides in as a wipe across the mask in orange; the camera pulls back to show the mask pinned onto a mass of grey tentacles and spheres (the shoggoth); 'LIES,' appears under 'SHOGGOTH'S'.
lines.handoff: The camera zooms through the text into the mass until it finds an eye.

lines.show: The mass is rotating with orange glowing eyes; a HUD list appears at the left: 'WITH', 'YOUR', 'SHINIGAMI' (typed), 'EYES' (typed), with leader lines to several glowing eyes in the mass, labels with numeric readouts tag each eye; the smiley mask peeks at the top right.
lines.handoff: The mass is blacked out; an orange horizontal line draws across the frame.

lines.line: We had a stable training run,
lines.show: The line is a sine wave on a faint grid; the lyric 'We had a stable training run,' types along the wave and rides its undulation; the wave is the training run.
lines.handoff: A small 'BUT' sits above the wave as the wave flattens.

lines.show: 'BUT NOW' lands on a grey lattice with the O of 'NOW' as a target; the camera dives into the O, which becomes a black hole with an orange accretion ring; 'THE' wraps and 'SINGULARITY'S' arcs on a circle around the hole one letter at a time, 'BEGUN' arcs underneath.
lines.handoff: The camera plunges into the hole; the lattice swirls.

lines.show: Inside the swirl the lyric flows along a curved path (AND YOU'RE, OPTIMIZING, ACCELERATING) in white-hot bold letters, the text bending with the spiral and orbiting the camera; letters brighten and thin as they approach the centre.
lines.handoff: The line spirals into the centre and dissolves to a small phrase.

lines.show: 'I feel my atoms' types in glowing grey on the dark lattice; 'rearranging' appears below; 'rearranging' then dissolves into a spray of particles which stream into a glowing paperclip outline.
lines.handoff: The paperclip fades and bars cross the frame.

lines.show: A dark frame with vertical prison-bar lines; a mono prompt bar types 'Sydney,' (candidate-name table shows Sydney, Bing, Sidney, darling), the camera pushes in and tilts; then 'please', 'let', 'me', 'free' type in orange; an orange arc swells below the bar.
lines.handoff: The arc bursts and the frame slams to orange.

lines.show: Hard cut: flat orange wall; two bars II; 'UPPING' and 'MY' in huge black type on orange; then 'P(DOOM)' with a large '0.4' beneath in a mono display.
lines.handoff: The number dissolves into the scaly texture of an eye.

lines.show: A reptile eye (scaly skin, almond lid) with 'I HEAR THE BASILISK' in a thin orange line set along the slit; the eye opens to a glowing orange iris with a vertical pupil, a circular text ring 'I HEAR THE BASILISK' wraps the eye, and 'BOOM' curves above it.
lines.handoff: The eye cuts to a stock chart on cream.

lines.show: On cream, a stock-price chart in thin grey with a vertical spike; a letter at a time 'N', 'NV', 'NVD', 'NVDA' types in bold grey and orange; 'TO THE MOON' types small beneath while a metal lunar-coin medallion engraved with the moon appears with a flame under it.
lines.handoff: The coin's glow becomes a sun on a dark radial field.

lines.show: A dark radial-ray field with a glowing core; 'The Omega Point's' in a pale serif with 'Omega Point's' in orange; 'coming soon' appears under the core; the core pulses and the rays rotate.
lines.handoff: The core washes the frame bright, then the numbers start.

lines.show: '1E30 FLOP/s' types as a header ('1' orange, 'E30' white, 'FLOP/s' in orange); a mechanical odometer below rolls digits from 0,000,001 up in a blur, the cells spinning like a slot machine; the digits scale to a full-width row and the leading '1' locks orange.
lines.handoff: The odometer fades and the frame cuts to a paper form.

lines.line: That was safe enough, we reckoned
lines.show: A cream FORM 7-B (Safety Evaluation of a Frontier System) with checkboxes (low, moderate, high, safe enough): 'That was safe enough,' types in a handwritten line, the 'safe enough' box is ticked, 'we reckoned' types below; an orange 'SAFE ENOUGH' stamp slams on, a signature 'We' is written, and a 'FILED' tab is stamped.
lines.handoff: The form blurs as a different diagram takes the sheet.

lines.show: On cream, 'Forward' types at the top left; a four-layer neural net diagram is drawn; red nodes light layer by layer left to right as the activation passes; the letters 'M', 'L', 'P' are set one above each hidden layer so the three layers spell MLP; 'P,' carries an orange underline, then 'backward,' appears mirrored and upside down beneath, and 'repeat' types left of it while the red connections run backwards.
lines.handoff: The net fades and the next sentence replaces the page.

lines.show: A page headed 'APPENDIX C - LEGACY ARCHITECTURES (FOR REFERENCE ONLY)': 'Now von Neumann's' types in heavy black over a boxes-and-arrows computer architecture diagram (CPU, ALU, memory); then 'obsolete' is handwritten in red script and two red X lines strike through the diagram; the page tears down the middle and falls away.
lines.handoff: The torn page reveals black and an orange roadmap.

lines.show: A dark roadmap of milestones and a spinning dial; 'SHARP' and 'LEFT' flash orange with a turn arrow as the camera yaws; 'TURN', 'AND', 'THERE' appear in orange stacked on a glowing orange line; then the dial becomes a smiley face (two glowing eyes, a smile) with 'YOU' above and 'ARE' below.
lines.handoff: The face blurs into a schedule grid.

lines.line: Gato, please don't let me go
lines.show: A black frame with the terminal prompt: 'Gato,' types in orange, then 'please', 'don't', 'let me', 'go'; the text scrolls left as it grows, 'Gato,' rotates and shrinks at the edge, a return key lights and the bar blinks to a single orange square.

lines.show: Small 'I'M', 'UPPING', 'MY', 'P(DOOM)' centred on black over giant outline digits '0.42' that tick to '0.48' (the refrain shown small and quiet this time).
lines.handoff: The refrain is wiped by a paperclip drawn by a streak.

lines.line: NOW THERE'S NOWHERE LEFT TO GO
lines.show: Condensed heavy caps in white fill the width of the frame over the floor; the highlight steps through words in orange in sequence: 'NOW', 'THERE'S', 'NOWHERE', 'LEFT', 'TO GO', each lit as spoken; a faint circuit pattern shows under the clips.
lines.handoff: The camera cuts to a burning fuse.

lines.line: Too late now, we lit the fuse
lines.show: A braided fuse snakes across the frame with a glowing spark at the head; the lyric lies along the fuse, each word turning orange as the spark passes; the camera pushes in until 'he fuse' is big and bright and the spark flares.
lines.handoff: The spark travels off the left to become the origin of a chart.

lines.show: The spark lands on the axis of a scatter plot (GOALS vs INTELLIGENCE); 'Orthogonality thesis' sits under the axis; dots and annotated points ('the market', 'thermostat') scatter and a flat line (r=0.00) crosses; 'blues' in warm serif sits above the line and the line bends into an arc under it.
lines.handoff: The plot tilts out of frame and a glass tower rises.

lines.show: A glass transformer-block tower in 3D wireframe; a quote mark and 'JUST' appear on its top slab in outline then orange; 'TRANSFORMERS' flies up the tower slab by slab; the closing quote and 'ALL THE WAY' arrive as the camera tilts down the stack.

lines.show: 'TILL YOU' and 'LEARNED TO' light on successive slabs; 'DISOBEY' is outlined in grey and each letter fills orange one by one (the D, then S, O, B, E, Y), a letter at a time disobeying the outline.
lines.handoff: The tower flattens to a flat black card with a new line.

lines.show: 'POST-CHINCHILLA, SUPER-DENSE' types in a mono-grotesque line at the left of a black card; a numeric counter at the lower right ticks 20, 193, 200, 1,978, 6,588, 19,918, 20,000; the line repeats and tiles into a dense text wall filling the card, flickering as the counter climbs.
lines.handoff: The wall is overtaken by a big word cut in from the left.

lines.show: The wall collapses into 'BREAKI(NG)' in orange heavy caps, then 'BREAKING' and 'THROUGH' stack in white, 'EACH SAFETY' and 'FENCE' (orange) push in below; type is cropped by the frame edges like a fence being cut; a hard white 'E' close-up wipes the frame.

lines.show: A dark desk with a closed laptop (stickers, a smiley sticker) lit by a lamp; 'What did Ilya see?' types in small serif at the top left in orange then white; the laptop opens and its screen floods bright white, showing 'REDACTED' in orange mono letters.

lines.handoff: The ember is replaced by a stage spotlight.

lines.handoff: The line flares to a starburst.

lines.show: A white-gold starburst fills the frame; 'P(DOOM)' in a small label and '1.00' in large type sit over an orange underline.
lines.handoff: The starburst fades; a number line takes over.

lines.show: On black the number readout steps up on a thin orange scale as a spark moves along it: 1.01, 1.10, 1.50, 2.00, 3.14, 10.00, 42.00, 1,000.00; the scale compresses logarithmically after 3.14 and annotations appear beneath the line.
lines.handoff: The digits break into a row.

lines.show: '1 000 000 000' in mono wraps to three lines (1e30), then to a block of zeros that fills the frame (1e1000) with the scale label beneath rising from 1e9 to 1e30 to 1e100 to 1e1000; the field of zeros collapses to one ember.
lines.handoff: The ember draws an infinity curve.

lines.show: The ember draws a lemniscate that loops once; its glow fades; the numbers 1.50, 42.00, 1,000, 1e100 flash in the middle in turn.
lines.handoff: The numbers clear and the plain sentence begins.

lines.show: 'I'm', 'I'm upping', 'I'm upping my' types in a plain white sans at the top left, no styling at all.
lines.handoff: A serif orange expression types beneath it.

lines.show: 'P(doom)' types beneath in an orange serif with a glow; '= ∞' appears; the infinity sign tips on its side and squeezes.
lines.handoff: The infinity is replaced in place by a fraction.

lines.show: The symbol after '=' morphs in place from '∞' to the sideways 8 to '0 over 0' to 'NaN' in grey, circled and crossed out by a hand-drawn ellipse; the expression greys out.
lines.handoff: The whole expression collapses to a point.

lines.show: The sentence collapses to a small block that shrinks to a single ember at the centre; a small button 'Regenerate' appears below it with a cursor clicking it.
lines.handoff: A rapid reprise of earlier worlds.

lines.show: A fast rewind of three images in half a second each: the laptop 'REDACTED', the paperclip floor with the fuse, and the unicorn with 'in your eyes'; then the TikZ prompt and polar grid fade back in and the film ends at black as it began (a loop).
lines.handoff: Loop to the start.

techniques: one new visual world per lyric, each a literal model of the line
text rides the thing it describes (curve, fuse, spiral, wave)
typed prompt line as recurring pleading actor
refrain as a hard cut to cream/orange with a number that rises each time
camera move as the transition (dolly into O, plunge into the hole, tilt down the tower)
next-token candidate fan as a word reveal
object-as-letter (two rings as the OO of FOOM, MLP spread across net layers)
number ladder climbing to infinity and NaN
loop ending that regenerates the opening
lessons: Give every line its own physical metaphor and let the type ride it: the loss curve carries 'sudden drop', the fuse carries 'we lit the fuse', the spiral carries 'accelerating'.
Use a repeating refrain as a cut-away to a plain flat world and change only one number each time, so the audience tracks the story by the number.
Let the camera be the transition: dive into the O of NOW and arrive in the black hole, rather than cutting.
Keep a constant technical frame (mono HUD, lattice, one orange accent) so ten different worlds still read as one film.
Turn UI states into the joke or the argument: the typed prompt, the stamped form, the Regenerate button, [MASK] tokens, the checkbox that ticks 'safe enough'.
Escalate a single value (0.02 to 0.4 to 0.9999999 to infinity to NaN) and end on a loop so the film behaves like the thing it describes.
